whole_picture_goal: One portrait-format finished oil painting of the specific animal from Image 1 in this new ordinary-life scene. Image 2 is ONLY the user-approved painting-quality reference: borrow connected volumes, purposeful marks, edges and character coherence, not its gray cat, surf shirt, logo, newspaper, bench or palette.
reconstruction_plan: Keep head, muzzle, eyes and ears individual, with paint turns and restrained asymmetry. Fur, cloth and object marks should explain their different volumes. Clothing follows the specified activity and body shape.
visibility_plan: Show the head, torso and all paws that perform the action; use natural framing for other limbs. Hands remain animal paws; object contacts and seated support stay credible. No extra fingers, limbs, caption, lettering, logos or physical frame.
background_plan: Subdued cool blue-gray room with a warm muted chair and one plain cushion; no street, van, bucket or signs. Keep background contrast subordinate to the face and relevant contacts; texture can vary without uniformly treating every surface.
